title: Aveir AR Coverage With Evidence Development (CED) Study
official: Aveir AR Coverage With Evidence Development (CED) Study
summary: The purpose of this coverage with evidence development (CED) study is to evaluate complications and long-term health outcomes of the single-chamber Aveir Atrial Leadless Pacemaker device (aka Aveir™ AR LP system).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Medicare beneficiaries implanted with an Aveir AR leadless pacemaker on or after the study start date (i.e., the date of Aveir AR market approval) will be included in the study.

   OR
2. Medicare beneficiaries implanted with a full system (e.g. lead and generator) single chamber atrial transvenous pacemaker on or after the study start date

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
